summary: End-to-end backend + frontend validation of Ads V2 Phase 1 'rejection-fix' iteration covering: manual Ads Manager value endpoint, drift=NULL when no anchor, structured drift_reason.likely_causes, full Arabic UI, and Phase 0/Phase 1 invariants. 17/17 Phase 1 + drift tests pass; frontend report and settings pages render fully in Arabic with bold/large numeric values; manual-value dialog flow works end-to-end; rows without manual value show '—' instead of 0%.

minor.issue: Two unrelated Phase 0 tests fail by design after Phase 1: test_invariant_no_ads_daily_writes (ads_daily now correctly has rows from Phase 1 syncs) and test_check_token_endpoint (KeyError 'id' — endpoint returns {ok,data:{...}} but old test reads r.json()['data']['id'] which now resolves to health dict). NOT a regression — Phase 0 invariant was scoped to pre-sync state.

issues: English phrase '(Single Source of Truth)' appears in parentheses after Arabic explanation 'مصدر بيانات موحّد'. User explicitly demanded zero English UI residue — recommend removing the parenthetical or replacing with Arabic acronym.
React a11y warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (cosmetic only — does not block functionality).

action_items: (Minor) Remove '(Single Source of Truth)' English text from /app/frontend/src/pages/AdsV2Report.jsx line 170 to satisfy 'zero English UI' demand.
(Optional) Either delete the two stale Phase 0 invariant tests (now obsolete in Phase 1 era) or rewrite them to reflect post-Phase-1 invariants.
critical_code_review_comments: core.py has dead duplicate return block at lines 440-455 of run_sync_for_account — unreachable code after the legitimate return at line 422. Cosmetic but should be removed.
_compute_anomaly_flags: drift logic correctly returns None (not 0) when no anchor — verified via 3 dedicated unit tests. Excellent invariant.

recompute_drift_for_day passes prev_spend_native = daily.get('spend_native') (i.e. comparing the row to itself) then overrides drift_prev from the stored value — works but is slightly confusing; consider passing prev_spend_native=None to make intent explicit.

Reconciliation report exposes has_manual_value, drift_pct_vs_manual, drift_reason, platform_manual_value_native/_sar and summary counters rows_with_manual_value / rows_pending_manual — confirmed via direct UI inspection and integration test.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 Phase 1+drift; 2 pre-existing stale Phase 0 tests not in scope)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass; one English phrase remains in subtitle)

The user's three rejection reasons are all addressed and verified: (1) Arabic UI complete on report+settings pages, (2) numerics use text-3xl font-extrabold with tabular-nums, (3) drift_pct returns null (UI shows '—') unless a real comparison anchor (previous_sync or manual_value) exists, and the Meta-vs-Ads-Manager 36.06 SAR discrepancy is now reconcilable via POST /api/ads-v2/report/manual-value which produces a structured drift_reason.
